rest.title: Compute Engine API v1 discovery document (Instance, AttachedDisk, GuestOsFeature, NetworkInterface, AliasIpRange, Scheduling schemas)

asset_type.format: A DNS-style service name and resource type, joined by a slash.

examples.note: the only asset type this pack's sourcetype carries

compute.googleapis.com/Instance.meaning: A Compute Engine virtual machine instance asset.

PROVISIONING.meaning: The instance is in Compute Engine's resource-allocation step, before it boots.

STAGING.meaning: Resources are set aside for it and the instance is being readied, one step short of its first boot.

STOPPING.meaning: Somewhere in the process of coming down, whether by a delete, a kill, or a graceful stop.

STOPPED.meaning: The instance has stopped, by explicit action or an underlying failure.

SUSPENDING.meaning: Midway through being paused, not yet fully suspended.

SUSPENDED.meaning: Paused and sitting idle; from here it can either resume or be deleted outright.

REPAIRING.meaning: Compute Engine's automated repair process has taken hold of it.

TERMINATED.meaning: Fully halted, with Compute Engine actively tearing down its attached network and disk resources.

DEPROVISIONING.meaning: The instance is halted while Compute Engine tears down networking, quota, IP and disks.

PENDING.meaning: A Flex Start instance is waiting for capacity from the Dynamic Workload Scheduler.

PENDING_STOP.meaning: On its way down gracefully, partway through the shutdown sequence.

examples.note: this sample's instance; the default for standard instances

MIGRATE.meaning: Compute Engine automatically migrates the instance out of the way of a maintenance event. The default for standard instances.

TERMINATE.meaning: Compute Engine stops the instance for a maintenance event instead of migrating it; automaticRestart controls whether it restarts afterward. The only option for preemptible instances.

READ_WRITE.meaning: The default attach mode: the disk accepts reads and writes, and only one instance can hold it this way at once.

READ_ONLY.meaning: The disk is attached read-only; several instances can share it in this mode at once.

examples.note: this sample's boot disk; the default for most machine types

SCSI.meaning: The disk attaches over SCSI, the default interface for most machine types.

NVME.meaning: The disk attaches over NVMe; used by local SSDs and, in some configurations, persistent disks.

examples.note: this sample's boot disk; the default

PERSISTENT.meaning: Storage provisioned as its own standalone resource, one that keeps existing even after the instance using it is gone; the default choice.

SCRATCH.meaning: A local scratch disk: physically attached, high performance, and lost if the instance stops or is deleted.

disk_guest_os_feature.format: One fixed, upper-case word naming a guest OS capability.

VIRTIO_SCSI_MULTIQUEUE.meaning: The guest OS image supports a multiqueue virtio-scsi controller.

UEFI_COMPATIBLE.meaning: Marks the image as bootable under UEFI, not only legacy BIOS.

examples.note: the raw top-level name field, this fixture
the TA's instance_name and nt_host, prefix stripped

instance_short_name.format: A DNS-label string: 1-63 characters, RFC1035 syntax.

examples.note: this sample; a synthetic fixture name, not a live instance

machine_type.format: Either the short machine-type name or the full machineType resource URL, depending on how the TA extracted it.

examples.note: the TA's instance_type, URL segment extracted

instance_address.format: The instance's IPv4 addresses: always an internal one, plus an external one only when an access config assigns it.

examples.note: internal address only; this instance has no accessConfigs, so no external address is added

zone.format: A zone URL, or its trailing <region>-<letter> segment.

examples.note: resource.location and the TA's vendor_region, zone segment

resource_ancestors.format: A multivalue list of relative resource names, project first.

account_id.format: This sourcetype never populates the field; it is carried for schema parity with other inventories.

examples.note: this sample; marks a GKE node pool member instance

boot_disk_source.format: Wherever the disk this instance boots from actually lives, given as its complete resource URL.

creation_time.format: RFC3339 timestamp with the zone's own UTC offset.

last_start_time.format: RFC3339 timestamp with the zone's own UTC offset.

disk_size_gb.format: A decimal digit string, base-2 gigabytes.

service_accounts.format: A list of { email, scopes } objects; empty when the instance has none attached.
